notes.title: Ski like never before!
notes.content:
Take your skiing experience in VR to a new level! 

[previewyoutube=r8U_ElsEBqQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’d like to show you the new Skiing VR game, where you can:


 Try the real skiing mechanics in VR 
 Ride epic slopes in the daytime or night
 Relax with free ride mode, face the time race or compete with AI
 Challenge your friends on hillsides and find out who is the best skier
 Gaze at beautiful snowy landscapes
 And yes, deers. We have some!


Try the demo and wishlist Skiing VR right now!

notes.title: Christmas update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35820847/f7c34b7d2a4fd2182ac1c467047d2300866514b4.jpg

Christmas is coming so Let's Go make a Christmas update as well!

We've added two new maps you can play on! They both have a new noticeable feature. Which one? Play new maps and you'll notice it! then please tell us what you thinking about it.

Existing map now have a new fancy looks.

Performance optimised.
Game client now haev reduced size as well.

Merry Christmas!
